result.title: A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression
result.comment: 54 pages, including supplementary material (Tables S1-S11 and Figures S1-S4). Interval summaries and probe-sensitivity CSV files are included as ancillary material
result.summary: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出四步评测协议，在相同部署预算下比较参考库压缩方法（如 PQ、int8 量化），用 200 次重校准建立参考分布，并测量阈值附近的决策不一致率，在 VisA、MVTec AD 上报告结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩后决策稳定性」与「近阈值样本 vs 正常留出集」的分层评估思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中停止或判定决策在压缩内部状态与阈值漂移下的可靠性评价方式，但对象为工业异常检测，迁移性尚需判断。
